_note: v2.1 Phase 1 canonical numbers; each block names its source under docs/env_v2/generated/v2_1/

analysis_set.exclusion_rule: reuse flag > 0 excluded (86); '.'-spelled duplicates dropped (2); window 2000-01-03..2024-12-31; Adj Close returns

value_json_labels.sigma_V: ADOPTED-NOT-YET-APPLIED (E1.2, full-scale recovery study 30 Aug 2026): estimator C is the only usable estimator by the pre-registered rule (median relative error 0.05 at its own cell, A fails on coverage, B is not identified), so its sigma_V = 0.01957 [0.01892, 0.02036] is the adopted FIT. It is NOT yet written into the generator: sigma_V changes every path, so applying it triggers the plan's execution-order rule (E1.4, E1.5, E1.1 and the Phase-1 after-state were all measured at 0.006). The value in force stays v2's stipulated 0.006 until the team decides whether to re-run the cascade now or fold the change into Phase 2's engine re-fit — DECISION_LOG P1-15. Caveat carried with the adoption: the recovery panels come from C's own model, so the usability test favours C by construction, and C's J = 66.6 on the real panel shows the model does not fit the data well.
value_json_labels.df_V: DESIGN (both variants carried; E1.3 runs Gaussian and t5): the panel's EPS-surprise tails are equivalent to neither N(0,1) nor t5 (KS upper limits 0.20 / 0.18; excess kurtosis 8.3)
value_json_labels.s_x_fit: FIT target for Phase 2 (E1.2 estimator C; not a generator parameter, so applied immediately)
value_json_labels.h_fit: FIT target for Phase 2 (E1.2 estimator C; days; not a generator parameter, so applied immediately). The engine's own pull-rate half-life in force is 150 d (CAL, v2 pilot) -- Phase 2 (E2.4/E2.6) reconciles them.
value_json_labels.start_price_mode: DESIGN (D13 revised 30 Aug 2026 by the team after E1.1: the provisional B fails the attacker and rule-100 tests, A and C pass; C keeps the hidden paths identical to B's and applies a per-seed render scale to every price-denominated rendered field; REG-1's LLM test in Phase 9 decides A vs C finally)
value_json_labels.start_price_range: FIT (P5-P95 of unadjusted Close, set A, 40 random dates; used by mechanisms A and C)
value_json_labels.jump: FIT/DESIGN E1.4 (29 Aug 2026): placement 'x_zero' by the pre-registered KS rule (KS rule: both bootstrap upper limits < 0.10, smallest window-day distance among passers); E[x] on 200 flat paths +0.0104 [-0.0085, +0.0299]: pre-registered TOST FAIL (undecidable at 200 seeds, PREREG_PHASE_1_ADDENDUM.md); two-condition reading pass; 1,000-seed TOST +0.0126 [+0.0038, +0.0214] FAIL -> provisional (new-a passed; new-b failed -> team decision). Total rate 0.010/day and size sd 0.03 CAL (v2 E1 calibration; Phase 3 re-fits); p_ann and lam_res FIT from the panel's window share of jump days q (e1_4/panel_split.json)
value_json_labels.burn_in: FIT/DESIGN E1.5 (29 Aug 2026; REG-17 rule: every variable's KS upper limit < 0.10 against the day-5000 reference of 2000 flat paths; PREREG_PHASE_1_ADDENDUM.md section 4): fw_fallback_hl150: A (750 d; both pass: A for the default engine (no artefact), B for the slow sensitivities; current 260 d passes); fw_hl60: B (60 d; both pass: A for the default engine (no artefact), B for the slow sensitivities; current 260 d passes); fw_index: B (60 d; both pass: A for the default engine (no artefact), B for the slow sensitivities; current 260 d FAILS); pruna: B (60 d; both pass: A for the default engine (no artefact), B for the slow sensitivities; current 260 d FAILS); ar1: B (60 d; both pass: A for the default engine (no artefact), B for the slow sensitivities; current 260 d passes). GenConfig.burn_in_mode = 'long' (the default engine's choice); engines adopting the other option keep their own days here and the report states the split

spec.source_note: E1.0 free panel (Yahoo via yfinance 1.6.0, SEC EDGAR company-facts, Shiller), 29 Aug 2026

summary.model: arch_model(100 r, mean=Constant, vol=GARCH, p=1, o=1, q=1, dist=t); persistence = alpha + gamma/2 + beta
summary.survivorship: set A = flag-free full-history survivors (no delistings by construction); set B = shorter flag-free series; tails and unconditional variance are understated relative to the full universe (REG-15); the literature values beside are index/portfolio-level and are NOT tolerances

mu_V.source: Shiller ie_data.xls via shillerdata.com (E1.0 need #4), column P (nominal S&P composite price), price-only
mu_V.literature_beside: DMS 2025 (read by the third pass, LOG 4.1): US 1900-2024 nominal equity return 9.7 %/yr (total return, incl. dividends); v2 used mu_V = 0.00025/day (6.5 %/yr, 'plan')

df_V.statistic: seasonal quarterly EPS change / own sd, pooled
df_V.rule: FIT gaussian if only the normal upper limit < 0.10; FIT t5 if only the t5 upper limit < 0.10; else DESIGN

vhat_noise.use: measurement-error sd (per year) of V_hat in the recovery study; persistence bracketed {0, 0.9}/quarter (DESIGN)

design.phi_rule: phi = ln2 / (h mu n_bar_ref), n_bar_ref 0.99765, w_bar_ref 0.76113 (the default engine's pilot constants)
design.usability_rule: median |h_hat - h|/h < 0.20 and coverage >= 0.90 (A, B); C: error only

h_s_x.reason: smallest RMSE among usable estimators whose data interval contains the other usable estimators' points (usable: ['C'])

sigma_V.reason: the only usable estimator with a sigma_V
